verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows approval workflows, policy-based auto-categorization, and claims of automated compliance (expensify-docs-27, expensify-docs-32, expensify-docs-30). None of it documents a per-expense audit trail recording edits, approvals, and policy checks, or any audit-ready history or export. Those are adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story, so an applicable axis with no direct evidence is 'none'.
